**Only remove packages on CI**

```{r}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(as.logical(Sys.getenv("CI", "false")))
#| include: false
#| messages: "NA"

# Remove the German babel and hyphenation packages to test auto-installation.
# Without hyphen-german, babel fails with a fatal error for `lang: de-CH`:
# "You haven't defined the language 'ngerman' yet."
for (pkg in c("hyphen-german", "babel-german")) {
  if (tinytex::check_installed(pkg)) {
    message("Removing '", pkg, "' package for the render")
    tinytex::tlmgr_remove(pkg)
  }
}
```

Dieses Dokument prüft, dass Quarto `babel-german` und `hyphen-german` automatisch installiert, wenn `lang: de-CH` verwendet wird (siehe auch rstudio/tinytex#515).
